name: PMIP4 / CMIP6 Paleoclimate Intercomparison
organization: WCRP Climate Model Intercomparison Project (CMIP6 / PMIP4)
domain: Coupled Ocean-Atmosphere General Circulation Models (GCMs) for Paleoclimate Benchmarks
spatial_resolution: 5 arc-min (~5 km) & 2.5 arc-min Downscaled PMIP4/CMIP6 Surfaces

citation: Brown, J.L., et al. (2018). PaleoCLIM, high-spatial resolution paleoclimate surfaces derived from PMIP4/CMIP6 GCM simulations. Scientific Data 5, 180254.
